# glinet_system (Data Source)

Read the verified router model, firmware version, and operating mode.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_system" "router" {}

output "firmware" {
  value = data.glinet_system.router.firmware
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `firmware` (String) Stock firmware version.
- `mode` (String) GL.iNet operating mode.
- `model` (String) Router model.
